question: What do you call an economic contraction (recession) followed by an expansion?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Business Cycle**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Business cycles** are one sort of variation that can be seen in a country's overall economic activity.
 
• It is a pattern of booms that occur roughly at the same time throughout various **economic activities**, followed by contractions that are equally widespread (**recessions**).
 
• An illustration of an **economic cycle** is the **business cycle**.
 
• Therefore, the correct option is "Business Cycle".​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A **production function** in economics describes the **technological relationship** between the amounts of physical inputs and the amounts of output of commodities.
 
• According to an economics theory, people construct their **expectations** for the future based on the past. This process is known as **adaptive expectations**.
